call_purpose: You contacted us because some of your students report that your course lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones, and you hope it gets sorted out.

covered.text: We opened the lesson link you shared on desktop in Chrome, in Safari and on a phone, and the video played on each, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side. This issue is not yet resolved.

customer_next_steps.text: Ask one of the affected students to record a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.

support_next_steps.text: We will raise this with our technical team and get back to you.
